extracted.intended_audience: children's book writers, illustrators, SCBWI members, publishers, and readers interested in children's and YA book awards
extracted.subtask_description: An announcement of the SCBWI Golden Kite Awards and Sid Fleischman Award winners and honors for children's and young adult books, listing categories, winners, honor books, and prize/donation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of excellence in the children's book community
rubrics_metrics.description: SCBWI's biggest award of the year, recognizing excellence in the children's book community since 1973!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The awards honor the best in children’s books and young adult fiction, with winners and honor book recipients announced in categories. (Page lists finalists, honors, and winners.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Sid Fleischman Award for Humor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category recognizing humor in children's/YA books. 2024 WINNER: To Catch a Thief by Martha Brockenbrough (Scholastic Press). 2024 HONOR: Fenway and the Loudmouth Bird by Victoria Coe, illustrated by Joanne Lew-Vriethoff (G.P. Putnam’s Sons Books for Young Readers). Includes listed beneficiary donations for winners/honorees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Book Text
rubrics_metrics.description: Golden Kite Award for Picture Book Text
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for text in picture books. 2024 WINNER: Nell Plants a Tree, written by Anne Wynter, illustrated by Daniel Miyares. 2024 HONOR: Salat in Secret, written by Jamilah Thompkins-Bigelow, illustrated by Hatem Aly. (Winners' donation choices listed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Book Illustration
rubrics_metrics.description: Golden Kite Award for Picture Book Illustration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for illustration in picture books. 2024 WINNER: Big, illustrated and written by Vashti Harrison. 2024 HONOR: Jumper: A Day in the Life of a Backyard Jumping Spider, illustrated and written by Jessica Lanan. (Winners' donation choices listed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonfiction Text for Younger Readers
rubrics_metrics.description: Golden Kite Award for Nonfiction Text for Younger Readers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for nonfiction text aimed at younger readers. 2024 WINNER: Tomfoolery: Randolph Caldecott and the Rambunctious Coming-of-Age of Children's Books, written by Michelle Markel, illustrated by Barbara McClintock. 2024 HONOR: Beautiful Noise: The Music of John Cage, written by Lisa Rogers, illustrated by Il Sung Na.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonfiction Text for Older Readers
rubrics_metrics.description: Golden Kite Award for Nonfiction Text for Older Readers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for nonfiction text aimed at older readers. 2024 WINNER: The 21: The True Story of the Youth Who Sued the U.S. Government Over Climate Change, written by Elizabeth Rusch. 2024 HONOR: Accountable: The True Story of a Racist Social Media Account and the Teenagers Whose Lives It Changed, written by Dashka Slater.

rubrics_metrics.name: Middle Grade Fiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Golden Kite Award for Middle Grade Fiction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for middle grade fiction. 2024 WINNER: The Lost Year, written by Katherine Marsh. 2024 HONOR: A First Time for Everything, written by Dan Santat.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustrated Book for Older Readers / Graphic Novels
rubrics_metrics.description: Golden Kite Award for Illustrated Book for Older Readers (Graphic Novels)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for illustrated books/graphic novels for older readers. 2024 WINNER: Curlfriends (New in Town), written and illustrated by Sharee Miller. 2024 HONOR: Super Boba Café, written and illustrated by Nidhi Chanani.

rubrics_metrics.name: Young Adult Fiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Golden Kite Award for Young Adult Fiction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for young adult fiction. 2024 WINNER: The Blood Years, by Elana K. Arnold. 2024 HONOR: This Town is on Fire, by Pamela N. Harris.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award levels and prize/donation structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Prize amounts and charitable donation component for winners and honor recipients
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The winner in each category received $2,500 plus an additional $1,000 to donate to a non-profit organization of their choice. Each honor recipient received $500 plus an additional $250 to donate. (The page lists each winner's named donation recipient.)
